英国短期学习签证（英语课程）: UK Short-term Study Visa (English language course)
UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI), Home Of: UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI), Home Office
英国为 6 个月以上、11 个月以内的英语语言课程设的短期学习签证。16 岁以上: A short-term study visa for English language courses lasting more than six months and up to eleven months. Anyone aged 16 or over can apply; there is no student-status requirement and no CAS from a sponsoring institution — the only institutional condition is that the school be officially accredited. Stay is the course length plus 30 days. It is one of the few routes that lets a working adult legally stay in the UK for close to a year, at the price of an explicit ban on any work during the stay.
官方资格页未对国籍设限，只要求 16 岁以上并被认证机构的英语课程录取。中国大陆: The eligibility page sets no nationality restriction; it only requires the applicant to be 16 or over and accepted onto an English language course at an accredited institution. Mainland China passport holders may apply, but as a visa-required nationality they must apply online before travelling to the UK.
官方原文 `You must be 16 or older to apply.`: The official wording is "You must be 16 or older to apply." There is no upper age limit anywhere in the text. Applicants under 18 must also provide evidence of travel and accommodation arrangements and written consent from a parent or guardian.
官方未设学历门槛，只要求被一所认证机构的英语语言课程录取。课程须为 6 个月以上: No education level is required; the only condition is acceptance onto an English language course at an accredited institution. The course must last more than six months and no more than eleven, and must include no other subjects (the official wording is "includes no other subjects").
官方未要求雅思/托福等任何语言考试成绩。课程本身就是英语课，学校可能自设分班测试: No IELTS, TOEFL or other language test score is required. The course itself is an English course; the school may run its own placement test, but that is not a visa condition.
须证明 `you have enough money to support yo: You must show that "you have enough money to support yourself without working or help from public funds", or that relatives or friends will support and house you; you must also be able to pay for your return or onward journey. No specific amount is published (unverified); the document list asks for bank statements or payslips covering the last six months.
结核病（TB）检查：中国在英国内政部公布的须做 TB 检查的国家名单内，且本签证: Tuberculosis (TB) test: China is on the Home Office list of countries whose residents must be tested, and this visa allows a stay of up to eleven months, which crosses the six-month threshold. A chest x-ray at an approved clinic is required, producing a certificate valid for six months, to be submitted with the application.
官方原文 `you can pay for your return or onw: The official wording is "you can pay for your return or onward journey".
官方明文 `bring family members ('dependants': The official text lists "bring family members ('dependants') with you on this visa" among the things you cannot do.
无年度名额限制，符合条件即可申请。真正的约束来自课程本身：必须是认证机构开设的: There is no annual quota; anyone who meets the conditions may apply. The real constraint sits with the course itself: it must be a six-to-eleven-month English-only course at an accredited institution.
全年可申请，无统一开放/截止日。官方原文：最早可在出发前 3 个月申请（`The: Applications run year-round with no common opening or closing date. The official wording: "The earliest you can apply is 3 months before you travel to the UK."
官方页写 `It usually costs £776`，按年计；不足一年的部分: The official page states "It usually costs £776", charged per year; partial years are prorated, and the exact amount is whatever the application system calculates at the time
官方原文：`you'll usually get a decision with: The official wording: "you'll usually get a decision within 3 weeks", counted from completing the online application, proving identity and submitting documents. A paid priority service is available.
当前有效护照或其他有效旅行证件: A current passport or other valid travel document
近 6 个月银行流水或工资单，证明无需工作即可自给: Bank statements or payslips for the last six months, showing you can support yourself without working
官方提示：拿到签证前不要先付住宿或机票钱: The official guidance is not to pay for accommodation or travel until the visa is granted
课程费用已缴或可支付的证明: Proof that course fees are paid or affordable
官方原文 `evidence that you've paid your cou: Official wording: "evidence that you've paid your course fees or have enough money to pay them"
须写明课程名称、时长与费用（含住宿）: Must state the course name, duration and cost, including accommodation
中国在须检名单内；胸片证明有效期 6 个月: China is on the testing list; the chest x-ray certificate is valid for six months
官方原文 `a certified translation if any doc: Official wording: "a certified translation if any documents are not in English or Welsh"
确认课程符合签证要求: Confirm the course meets the visa rules
课程须为英语语言课程、时长 6–11 个月、不含其他科目，且学校是认证机构（有学: The course must be an English language course, six to eleven months long, with no other subjects, at an accredited institution (holding a student sponsor licence, or listed by ASIC, Accreditation UK, BAC, Ofsted, QAA and similar bodies). Courses of six months or less go through a Visitor visa; anything over eleven months goes through a Student visa.
拿到录取通知书并备齐材料: Obtain the offer letter and assemble documents
录取通知书须写明课程名称、时长与费用。同时准备资金证明、住宿与行程说明、课程费支: The offer letter must state the course name, duration and cost. Prepare funds evidence, accommodation and travel plans, and proof of course fee payment. Mainland China applicants also need the TB test.
在线申请（最早出发前 3 个月）: Apply online (no earlier than three months before travelling)
必须在线申请，并预约签证申请中心提交材料、核验身份。缴费 £228 签证费 +: Applications are online only, plus an appointment at a visa application centre to submit documents and prove identity. Pay the £228 visa fee plus the IHS, which the official page states usually costs £776.
官方口径为通常 3 周出结果。可付费加急。结果以邮件通知。: The official line is a decision within three weeks. A paid priority service is available. The outcome arrives by email.
赴英就学（期间不得工作）: Study in the UK (no work permitted)
可停留课程时长 + 30 天，总长不超过 11 个月。期间不得从事任何有薪或无薪: You may stay for the course length plus 30 days, capped at eleven months. During that time you may not do paid or unpaid work, work experience or work placements, may not switch to another course, may not extend the visa, and may not bring dependants.
不可延期。官方原文 `extend this visa` 列在不可以做的事里。若: Not extendable. The official text lists "extend this visa" among the things you cannot do. To keep studying in the UK you would have to switch to a Student visa, which carries a different set of requirements and costs.
课程以外的任何其他科目: Any subject other than the enrolled course
这是本签证最关键的限制：官方原文 `work or carry out any: This is the visa's single most important limit: the official text bans "work or carry out any business (this includes paid or unpaid work, work experience or work placements)" outright. It therefore suits pure language study only and cannot be packaged as "study and work while travelling". Stay equals course length plus 30 days, capped at eleven months.
持此签证期间不得从事任何工作，包括无薪实习与工作体验（官方原文明确列出 paid: No work of any kind is permitted on this visa, including unpaid internships and work experience — the official text names paid or unpaid work, work experience and work placements explicitly. Marketing it as "study abroad and work at the same time" directly contradicts the government wording.
必须先在出发前拿到签证才能入境，且最早只能提前 3 个月申请。官方提醒在拿到签证: The visa must be granted before travelling, and applications open no earlier than three months ahead. The official guidance warns against paying for accommodation or flights before the visa is granted. Poor timing costs real money in course fees and travel bookings.
课程必须是认证机构开设的纯英语课程，6–11 个月。认证名单是封闭的（学生担保牌: The course must be English-only and six to eleven months long at an accredited institution. The accreditation list is closed (student sponsor licence, ASIC, Accreditation UK, BAC, Ofsted, QAA and others), so a language school outside it cannot support a successful application however long you study there.
中国大陆申请人在须做结核病检查的国家名单内，须在指定诊所拍胸片，证明有效期仅 6: Mainland China applicants are on the TB testing list and must have a chest x-ray at an approved clinic; the certificate is valid for only six months. This is an easy requirement to miss, and missing it leads to refusal.
不可延期、不可带家属、不可转其他课程。想长期留在英国必须换学生签证，那需要 CA: No extension, no dependants and no switching courses. Staying in the UK longer means switching to a Student visa, which requires a CAS and a higher funds threshold — a different cost base entirely.
优势：16 岁以上不看学籍、不需 CAS、无语言考试门槛；总成本（£228 签证: Advantages: no student-status test from age 16, no CAS, no language test requirement; the total cost (£228 visa fee plus £776 IHS) is roughly 10,000 CNY, below the Student visa route; and it is one of the few ways a working adult can stay in the UK legally for close to a year.
总览页原文：`You may be eligible for a Short-t: Overview page as written: "You may be eligible for a Short-term study visa if you're taking an English language course in the UK. To apply, your course must last longer than 6 months but not more than 11 months." Stay: "You can stay in the UK for the length of your course plus an extra 30 days as long as your stay is no longer than 11 months." Cost: "It costs £228 for a Short-term study visa." plus "It usually costs £776" for the IHS. Prohibitions: "You cannot: ... work or carry out any business (this includes paid or unpaid work, work experience or work placements) ... extend this visa ... bring family members ('dependants') with you on this visa". The page also directs courses of six months or less to a Visitor visa and courses over eleven months to a Student visa.
Eligibility page as written: "You must be 16 or older to apply." You must prove "you've been accepted onto an English language course that lasts longer than 6 months and up to 11 months and includes no other subjects", that "your course is with an accredited institution", that "you have enough money to support yourself without working or help from public funds", and that "you can pay for your return or onward journey". Under-18s additionally need travel and accommodation arrangements and parental or guardian consent.
课程与机构认证要求原文：课程须与 `an 'accredited institu: Course and accreditation requirements as written: the course must be with "an 'accredited institution'", meaning one holding a student sponsor licence or listed by ASIC, Accreditation UK, British Accreditation Council, Education and Training Inspectorate, Estyn, Education Scotland, Independent Schools Inspectorate, Ofsted, Office for Students or QAA. A second route covers overseas higher education institutions teaching part of a course in the UK, requiring that the institution "hold its own national accreditation", "offer no more than half of its educational programme in the UK", and "offer programmes that are equivalent to a UK degree".
材料清单原文：`a current passport`、`evidence th: Document list as written: "a current passport"; "evidence that you can support yourself during your trip, for example bank statements or payslips for the last 6 months"; "details of where you intend to stay and your travel plans - you should not pay for accommodation or travel until you get your visa"; "evidence that you've paid your course fees or have enough money to pay them"; "your tuberculosis (TB) test results, if you're from a country where you have to take the TB test"; and "a certified translation if any documents are not in English or Welsh".
申请流程与审理时长原文：`The earliest you can apply: Application process and processing time as written: "The earliest you can apply is 3 months before you travel to the UK."; "you'll usually get a decision within 3 weeks"; "You may be able to pay to get a faster decision."; "You'll only get your fee refunded if UKVI has not started processing your application."
TB 检查国家名单中 `China` 在列（名单按字母排序，China 位于 C: "China" appears on the TB test country list (alphabetically after Chad, Cameroon and Congo). The triggers, as written on the TB test overview page, are: "you're coming to the UK for 6 months or more", "you've lived in any of these listed countries for 6 months or more", and "you were living there (or another listed country) within the last 6 months". The certificate is valid for six months.
用于划清与访问签证的边界：访问签证可 `visit the UK ... for: Included to mark the boundary with the Visitor route: a Standard Visitor may "visit the UK ... for tourism, business, study (courses up to 6 months)" and may "do a recreational course of up to 30 days", but equally "You cannot: do paid or unpaid work for a UK company". Courses of six months or less go through the Visitor route, six-to-eleven-month English-only courses through this visa, and neither permits work.
